name: Trade Type 3 Code
definition: Specifies the type of executed order.

BSKT.name: Basket
BSKT.definition: A basket trade, i.e. a unit of 15 or more financial instruments used in program trading.

INDX.name: Index
INDX.definition: A trade of a predetermined set of financial instruments.

IPOO.name: IPO
IPOO.definition: Transaction is an Initial Public Offer (IPO) order.

LIST.name: List
LIST.definition: A trade of a predetermined set of financial instruments.

PROG.name: Program
PROG.definition: A program trade, i.e. a computer-driven trade of buying and selling of baskets of 15 or more financial instruments by index arbitrage specialists or institutional traders.

BRBR.name: Broker To Broker
BRBR.definition: A trade from a broker to another broker.

VWAP.name: VWAP Guarantee
VWAP.definition: Trade whose price is guaranteed as the weighted average of the trade prices on a specific day.

AGEN.name: Agency
AGEN.definition: Trade in which an agent intermediates between a buyer and a seller.

GUAR.name: Guaranteed Close
GUAR.definition: Trade which is guaranteed to be finalized.

EMTR.name: Employee Trade Reporting
EMTR.definition: Transaction relates to employee trade reporting.

ISSU.name: Issuance
ISSU.definition: Relates to the issuance of a security such as an equity or a depositary receipt.

BOST.name: Bond Start
BOST.definition: The trade is a Bond start.

BOEN.name: Bond End
BOEN.definition: The trade is a Bond end.

LABO.name: Lending And Borrowing
LABO.definition: Indicates that the trade is a Lending and borrowing.

BORE.name: Bond Repricing
BORE.definition: The trade is a Bond repricing.

OFIT.name: Offering Issuing Trade
OFIT.definition: Indicates that the trade is a Offering issue trade.

BOSU.name: Bond Substitution
BOSU.definition: The trade is a Bond substitution.

FBBT.name: Future Buy Back Trade
FBBT.definition: The security will be bought back in the future.

OPTN.name: Options
OPTN.definition: Indicates that the trade is a Option contract trade.

FUOP.name: Futures Option
FUOP.definition: Indicates that the trade is a Futures option contract trade.

FUTR.name: Futures
FUTR.definition: Indicates that the trade is a Futures contract trade.
